create_BoxList: create a BoxList from a numpy array of bounding box coordinates in y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max format
get_box_coordinates: get the corner coordinates of all boxes in the BoxList as separate y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max arrays
add_field_to_BoxList: add a custom field like classification scores to a BoxList with matching dimensions
get_field_from_BoxList: retrieve data from a specified field in the BoxList including boxes or extra fields
check_BoxList_validity: validate that bounding box data has correct dimensions and y_max >= y_min, x_max >= x_min
